name: number_to_words
description: Write numbers out in words in Spanish, English, French, German or Portuguese: cardinals, ordinals and currency amounts. Follows each language's rules: Spanish uno/un/una and veintiún, cien/ciento, long scale (un millón, mil millones, un billón); French quatre-vingts, soixante et onze, Belgian and Swiss septante/huitante/nonante and the 1990 hyphenation; German compounds (eintausendzweihundertvierunddreißig) with separate Million/Milliarde nouns; English short scale with US or British 'and'; Portuguese 'e' rules, pt-PT long and pt-BR short scale. Negatives, decimals and EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, MXN, BRL or your own currency names.

number.description: Integer, or a decimal string with a point ("-1234.05"); below 10^36

gender.description: es, fr, pt (una, une, duas, doscientas); de with before_noun (eine)

before_noun.description: Cardinal placed before a noun: es un/veintiún, primer/tercer; de ein/eine

orthography.description: French: 1990 joins every compound numeral with hyphens

decimals.description: Fractional part digit by digit or as a number; default digits for en and de, number for es, fr, pt

unit.description: Your own currency names (100 subunits per unit), instead of currency

catalog.source: original; rules from the RAE Diccionario panhispánico de dudas and Nueva gramática (numerales), the Académie française and the 1990 Rectifications de l'orthographe, Duden (Zahlwörter), and standard English and Portuguese grammars
